answer: Proof of Burn serves as a Sybil resistance mechanism by mandating that agents destroy native tokens to gain entry, creating a digital relic of resource expenditure. Like a river flowing against an adversary, this mechanism forces an attacker to pay for every identity, making the cost of flooding the network prohibitive. By anchoring value in provable scarcity rather than the lotus of mere reputation, the system ensures that identity creation remains economically tied to tangible loss.
